title: Getting Started with gghoneycomb
text: honeycomb layout useful showing proportional abundance categories. example, visualize pollen composition honey sample.
code: library(ggplot2) library(gghoneycomb) pollen <- data.frame(   species = c("Clover", "Wildflower", "Lavender", "Sunflower", "Other"),   count = c(45, 25, 15, 10, 5) )  ggplot(pollen, aes(fill = species, weight = count)) +   geom_honeycomb(n_cells = 80, silhouette = "rounded", layout = "free", seed = 1) +   scale_fill_honey() +   theme_honeycomb() +   coord_equal()

title: Getting Started with gghoneycomb
text: provide n_cells, gghoneycomb chooses value based number categories smallest proportion. rule thumb, cell counts 50 500 tend work well plots; higher values increase detail can make small regions harder see.
code: ggplot(pollen, aes(fill = species, weight = count)) +   geom_honeycomb(silhouette = "rect") +   scale_fill_honey() +   theme_honeycomb() +   coord_equal()

title: Getting Started with gghoneycomb
text: already proportions, set values_are = "proportions" pass values via weight aesthetic.
code: pollen_prop <- data.frame(   species = c("Clover", "Wildflower", "Lavender", "Sunflower", "Other"),   prop = c(0.45, 0.25, 0.15, 0.10, 0.05) )  ggplot(pollen_prop, aes(fill = species, weight = prop)) +   geom_honeycomb(values_are = "proportions", n_cells = 80, seed = 1) +   scale_fill_honey(direction = -1) +   theme_honeycomb() +   coord_equal()

title: Getting Started with gghoneycomb
text: silhouette parameter controls overall shape honeycomb: "rect" (default): clean rectangular grid. "rounded": softened corners organic feel. "organic": irregular boundary grown central seed. Pair silhouette layout = "free" temperature fine-tune amount jitter layout.
code: ggplot(pollen, aes(fill = species, weight = count)) +   geom_honeycomb(n_cells = 80, silhouette = "organic",                  layout = "free", temperature = 0.35, seed = 42) +   scale_fill_honey() +   theme_honeycomb() +   coord_equal()

title: Getting Started with gghoneycomb
text: compact_style = "blocky" carves rectangular blocks instead minimizing perimeter. requires silhouette = "rect" produces treemap-like appearance category occupies roughly rectangular region.
code: ggplot(pollen, aes(fill = species, weight = count)) +   geom_honeycomb(     n_cells       = 100,     silhouette    = "rect",     layout        = "compact",     compact_style = "blocky"   ) +   scale_fill_honey() +   theme_honeycomb() +   coord_equal()

title: Getting Started with gghoneycomb
text: rotation parameter rotates rendered honeycomb 90-degree increments (0, 90, 180, 270). Rotation coordinate transform applied allocation, category regions contiguity unchanged. Use switch portrait landscape orientations.
code: ggplot(pollen, aes(fill = species, weight = count)) +   geom_honeycomb(     n_cells    = 100,     silhouette = "rect",     rotation   = 90,     seed       = 1   ) +   scale_fill_honey() +   theme_honeycomb() +   coord_equal()

title: Getting Started with gghoneycomb
text: layout = "free" mode, temperature controls loosely allocator samples candidate cells. default 0.35. Higher values (e.g., 0.8) widen frontier invert scoring preferences, producing irregular, less compact category regions. Per-category contiguity still guaranteed regardless temperature.
code: ggplot(pollen, aes(fill = species, weight = count)) +   geom_honeycomb(     n_cells     = 100,     silhouette  = "organic",     layout      = "free",     temperature = 0.8,     seed        = 7   ) +   scale_fill_honey() +   theme_honeycomb() +   coord_equal()

title: Honeycomb Plots for ggplot2
text: category occupies single connected region hexagons, relative sizes read glance Three silhouette shapes: "rect" (clean grid), "rounded" (softened corners), "organic" (irregular, grown seed) Two layout modes: "compact" (deterministic, perimeter-minimizing blocky) "free" (stochastic, controlled temperature) Compact styles: "perimeter" minimizes region boundary length; "blocky" carves rectangular blocks (requires silhouette = "rect") Honey-inspired discrete color palette via scale_fill_honey() scale_color_honey() Minimal void-based theme via theme_honeycomb() Fully reproducible layouts seed parameter Output rotation 90-degree increments via rotation (0, 90, 180, 270)

title: Honeycomb waffle chart — geom_honeycomb
text: mapping Set aesthetic mappings created ggplot2::aes(). Required: fill (category) weight (numeric values). data data displayed layer. stat statistical transformation use data. Default "honeycomb". position Position adjustment, either string result position adjustment function. typically used honeycomb plots. na.rm FALSE, default, missing values removed warning. TRUE, missing values silently removed. show.legend Logical. layer included legends? inherit.aes FALSE, overrides default aesthetics rather combining . values_are interpret weight aesthetic values: "auto" (Default) weights sum 1 (within tolerance 1e-6), treat proportions; otherwise treat counts. "counts" Treat weights raw counts normalized. "proportions" Treat weights proportions (must sum 1). n_cells Number hexagonal cells use. NULL (default), automatically chosen based number categories minimum proportion. Maximum allowed 2500. silhouette Shape overall honeycomb boundary. Accepted values: "rect" (default), "rounded", "organic". three silhouettes produce connected mask requested size. "rounded" softens corners rectangular grid; "organic" grows irregular boundary central seed. layout Region allocation strategy. Accepted values: "compact" (default), "free". "compact" assigns cells deterministically (temperature must 0); "free" uses stochastic top-K sampling controlled temperature. compact_style Style region packing layout = "compact". Accepted values: "perimeter" (default), "blocky". "perimeter" minimises region perimeter via greedy growth carve fallback; "blocky" uses directional face-carving. "blocky" requires silhouette = "rect". temperature Controls randomness region allocation. single non-negative number: NULL (Default) Automatically set: 0 layout = "compact", 0.35 layout = "free". 0 Deterministic allocation. Required layout = "compact". > 0 Increasing randomness. valid layout = "free". min_width, max_width Constraints grid width (number columns). Default NULL means constraint. min_height, max_height Constraints grid height (number rows). Default NULL means constraint. seed Random seed reproducible layouts. NULL, uses random seed. rotation Rotation rendered honeycomb degrees. Must one 0, 90, 180, 270. code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(ggplot2)  # Example with counts df <- data.frame(   category = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),   count = c(40, 30, 20, 10) )  ggplot(df, aes(fill = category, weight = count)) +   stat_honeycomb()  # Example with proportions df_prop <- data.frame(   category = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),   prop = c(0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1) )  ggplot(df_prop, aes(fill = category, weight = prop)) +   stat_honeycomb(values_are = "proportions")  # Free layout with high temperature and rotation ggplot(df, aes(fill = category, weight = count)) +   stat_honeycomb(     n_cells     = 100,     silhouette  = "organic",     layout      = "free",     temperature = 0.8,     rotation    = 90,     seed        = 7   )  # Blocky compact style (requires silhouette = "rect") ggplot(df, aes(fill = category, weight = count)) +   stat_honeycomb(     n_cells       = 100,     silhouette    = "rect",     layout        = "compact",     compact_style = "blocky"   ) } # }

title: gghoneycomb 0.0.0.9000 (development)
text: silhouette = "rect" (default): clean rectangular grid, footprint . silhouette = "rounded": rectangular grid softened corners friendlier look. silhouette = "organic": irregular boundary grown outward central seed, producing natural, blob-like shape.

title: gghoneycomb 0.0.0.9000 (development)
text: layout = "compact" (default): deterministic region allocation. temperature must 0 (default). layout = "free": stochastic top-K sampling. temperature controls randomness; default 0.35. Requires seed reproducibility.

title: gghoneycomb 0.0.0.9000 (development)
text: compact_style = "perimeter" (default): greedy growth minimizes region perimeter step, carve fallback guarantee contiguity. compact_style = "blocky": directional face-carving produces rectangular, treemap-like blocks. Requires silhouette = "rect".
